import requests

from identity_client import get_identity_config, build_headers, build_url, normalize_locale
from identity_models import RegisterUserRequest, RegisterUserResponse, extract_token_pair, normalize_user_record

PROVIDER_NAME = "auth0"


def register_user(email: str, password: str, locale: Optional[str] = None, metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> RegisterUserResponse:
    cfg = get_identity_config()
    req = RegisterUserRequest(email=email, password=password, locale=normalize_locale(locale), metadata=metadata or {})
    payload = {
        "email": req.email,
        "password": req.password,
        "connection": cfg.auth0_database_connection,
        "user_metadata": {"locale": req.locale, **req.metadata},
    }
    resp = requests.post(
        build_url(cfg, f"/api/v2/users"),
        headers=build_headers(cfg),
        json=payload,
        timeout=cfg.timeout_seconds,
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    data = resp.json()
    user = normalize_user_record(data)
    tokens = extract_token_pair(data)
    return RegisterUserResponse(user=user, tokens=tokens)

","identity_client.py":"import os
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Dict, Optional

AUTH0_DOMAIN_ENV = "AUTH0_DOMAIN"
AUTH0_CLIENT_ID_ENV = "AUTH0_CLIENT_ID"
AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET_ENV = "AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET"
AUTH0_AUDIENCE_ENV = "AUTH0_AUDIENCE"
AUTH0_DATABASE_CONNECTION_ENV = "AUTH0_DATABASE_CONNECTION"
AUTH0_ORGANIZATION_ID_ENV = "AUTH0_ORGANIZATION_ID"
AUTH0_MANAGEMENT_API_TOKEN_ENV = "AUTH0_MANAGEMENT_API_TOKEN"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class IdentityConfig:
    auth0_domain: str
    auth0_client_id: str
    auth0_client_secret: str
    auth0_audience: str
    auth0_database_connection: str
    auth0_organization_id: Optional[str]
    auth0_management_api_token: Optional[str]
    timeout_seconds: float = 20.0



def get_identity_config() -> IdentityConfig:
    return IdentityConfig(
        auth0_domain=os.environ[AUTH0_DOMAIN_ENV],
        auth0_client_id=os.environ[AUTH0_CLIENT_ID_ENV],
        auth0_client_secret=os.environ.get(AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET_ENV, ""),
        auth0_audience=os.environ.get(AUTH0_AUDIENCE_ENV, ""),
        auth0_database_connection=os.environ.get(AUTH0_DATABASE_CONNECTION_ENV, "Username-Password-Authentication"),
        auth0_organization_id=os.environ.get(AUTH0_ORGANIZATION_ID_ENV),
        auth0_management_api_token=os.environ.get(AUTH0_MANAGEMENT_API_TOKEN_ENV),
    )



def build_url(cfg: IdentityConfig, path: str) -> str:
    return f"https://{cfg.auth0_domain}{path}"



def build_headers(cfg: IdentityConfig, content_type: str = "application/json") -> Dict[str, str]:
    headers = {"Content-Type": content_type}
    if cfg.auth0_management_api_token:
        headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {cfg.auth0_management_api_token}"
    return headers



def normalize_locale(locale: Optional[str]) -> Optional[str]:
    if not locale:
        return None
    value = locale.strip().replace("_", "-")
    return value.lower() if len(value) == 2 else value

class UserRecord:
    user_id: Optional[str] = None
    email: Optional[str] = None
    email_verified: Optional[bool] = None
    name: Optional[str] = None
    locale: Optional[str] = None
    raw: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class RegisterUserRequest:
    email: str
    password: str

    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class LoginRequest:

    password: str
    locale: Optional[str] = None

class RefreshRequest:

    scope: Optional[str] = None

class PasswordResetRequest:
    email: str
    locale: Optional[str] = None


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class RegisterUserResponse:
    user: UserRecord
    tokens: TokenPair


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class LoginResponse:
    user: UserRecord
    tokens: TokenPair


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class RefreshResponse:
    tokens: TokenPair


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PasswordResetResponse:
    message: str



def normalize_user_record(data: Dict[str, Any]) -> UserRecord:
    return UserRecord(
        user_id=data.get("user_id") or data.get("sub") or data.get("id"),
        email=data.get("email"),
        email_verified=data.get("email_verified"),
        name=data.get("name") or data.get("nickname") or data.get("given_name"),
        locale=data.get("locale"),
        raw=data,
    )



def extract_token_pair(data: Dict[str, Any]) -> TokenPair:
    return TokenPair(
        access_token=data.get("access_token"),
        id_token=data.get("id_token"),
        refresh_token=data.get("refresh_token"),
        token_type=data.get("token_type"),
        expires_in=data.get("expires_in"),
    )

from openai import OpenAI

from identity_client import normalize_locale

OPENAI_MODEL = "gpt-4o-mini"


def welcome_translate(text: str, target_locale: str, source_locale: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
    client = OpenAI()
    tgt = normalize_locale(target_locale) or target_locale
    src = normalize_locale(source_locale)
    system = "You translate onboarding copy faithfully and keep meaning concise."
    user = f"Translate this onboarding copy into {tgt}."
    if src:
        user += f" Source locale: {src}."
    response = client.chat.completions.create(
        model=OPENAI_MODEL,
        messages=[{"role": "system", "content": system}, {"role": "user", "content": f"{user}\n\n{text}"}],
        temperature=0.2,
    )
    return response.choices[0].message.content or ""

from openai import OpenAI

OPENAI_MODEL = "gpt-4o-mini"


def profile_moderation(profile_text: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    client = OpenAI()
    response = client.moderations.create(
        model=OPENAI_MODEL,
        input=profile_text,
    )
    result = response.results[0]
    return {
        "flagged": result.flagged,
        "categories": dict(result.categories),
        "category_scores": dict(result.category_scores),
    }

def onboarding_summary(state: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    client = OpenAI()
    prompt = {
        "account_state": state.get("account_state"),
        "locale": state.get("locale"),
        "moderation": state.get("moderation"),
        "notes": state.get("notes", []),
        "events": state.get("events", []),
    }
    response = client.chat.completions.create(
        model=OPENAI_MODEL,
        messages=[
            {"role": "system", "content": "Summarize onboarding state for support in a compact, factual way."},
            {"role": "user", "content": str(prompt)},
        ],
        temperature=0.1,
    )
    return response.choices[0].message.content or ""

from google.cloud import firestore

FIRESTORE_COLLECTION = "onboarding_notes"


def profile_note_store(note_id: str, note: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    db = firestore.Client()
    doc_ref = db.collection(FIRESTORE_COLLECTION).document(note_id)
    doc_ref.set(note, merge=True)
    return {"note_id": note_id, "stored": True}
